t: You're standing on Eaton Place, a street in Belgravia, in the City of Westminster, with a part of it falling in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It's best known as an address, and here the thing to know is simple: the philanthropist William Lee Ewart was born on this street. He was English, and he lived from 1836 to 1892, so his whole life fits inside the Victorian age. Beyond that, the material I have is thin, so I'll leave it there.
